headline: Executive order restricts Americans from investing in stocks and other securities that help fund certain Chinese companies.
what_it_does: The order addresses US investment in publicly traded securities that provide money to certain companies in the People's Republic of China. It treats these investments as a national security threat and sets limits on Americans buying or holding them. The title alone does not say which companies are covered or how the rules work.

who_it_affects.group: US investors, including individuals and investment funds
who_it_affects.how: They may be barred from buying or holding securities tied to the covered Chinese companies.
They may lose access to money from American investors.
